review_description: I've just had Tilstons instal 6.6kW of Trina panels and a Sungrow 5kW inverter, battery ready, supplementing a 10 year old 5kW system consisting of 5kW of north facing Trina panels and an SMA 5kW inverter. I opted for 2/3 of the panels west facing and 1/3 north facing. This was 2 days ago. Yesterday was the first full day of operation and despite being overcast I still produced 72kWh total.Tilstons have been easy to deal with, punctual, professional, efficient and tidy with the instal. They explained the operation of the system and got me loaded up with the app on my phone for system monitoring. Early days yet but very happy so far.

Tilstons provided a good priced comparative quote after some back and forth between 2 installers. Would have liked a person to come review property first in hindsight so some things could have been sorted easier.Install was good. Team was here for 3 days. Clean up was well done.With solar system and battery price before rebates about $29k after rebates about $22kWould happily recommend Tilstons
Adaptable package that can grow with time, bundled with other home improvements

The quoting experience was very professional and I did not feel pressured to go with them. Some of the other installers I found sign you up to their distribution email list and spam your inbox. This does not occur with Tilstons.The installation was very professional. Our 12.67Kw system was installed over 2 days. The installers were very tidy and cleaned up at the end of each day.At the end of the installation the team set up my connection to the grid and also my phone to monitor the data from the inverter.Overall it was a great experience and will definitely reach out to them in the future for a battery installation.

I contacted Adrian after a recommendation from a good friend. The quotation process was fast and easy. Adrian answered my many technical questions and provided excellent detailed advice.  We ordered a 3 phase system comprising 27 KW of panels and a 20 KW inverter, with all the required wiring and switching for batteries at a later stage. There was a delay of a few weeks in the installation of the panels due to Tilston's high workload at the time, but that really suited us because we had to dig a 100 metre trench for the underground cable from the site of the panels to the grid connection point before we could connect the solar. Tilston's installers were very efficient and easy to deal with despite the difficulties of our rural site.  The system was up and going in a few days and is performing very well, delivering 20.8 KV when necessary but it even delivers 8 KV on an overcast day, enough to run our 10 HP 3 phase bore pump. Our last power bill before going solar was $6,200 for 3 months. Now Origin is charging us about $5 per day on average, about $450 for 3 months - and it is currently winter. We are thinking about a battery and an EV now as we are putting about 40 KwH into the grid each day for 5 cents per KwH in June and we will probably double that in summer.  We are very happy with the new solar system and the after-sales service from Tilstons,
From quote to installation was easy as. Installation was quick,  done over 2 days. Great job from Tilsons electrical in Orange NSW

Installation was efficient and very neat. Best installation job of 3 systems I have installed over the years and 2 different properties.Everything exp[lained well and communication on the job during installation was excellent. We have engaged them now to upgrade our aircon.

Tilstons installation team were ahead of schedule so they rang me to ask if they could come a day early and start the project. Very friendly team and as far as i can tell they did a great job. Very happy with the experience.
